# Ticket 31: accepted TruffleHog findings for the repository scan (the
# `secrets` CI job). One per line:
#
#   <trufflehogFingerprint/v1> <expiry YYYY-MM-DD> <reason>
#
# The fingerprint is `partialFingerprints."trufflehogFingerprint/v1"` from
# the job's SARIF (or `trufflehog git file://. --sarif` locally). Every entry
# needs a reason and an expiry; an expired entry stops applying, so the
# finding blocks again until someone re-reviews it. Never allowlist a real
# credential: rotate it instead (see README, "If a secret is found").
#
# A fingerprint identifies one occurrence, so it stays valid as history grows;
# the same value added again elsewhere is a new finding with a new fingerprint.
